topic: A weekend visit to the botanical garden
passage: Last Saturday morning, I set off for the city botanical garden with my wife. I looked up the opening hours and wrote down the gate number. We arrived at nine and lined up at the ticket window. I paid for two tickets and handed one over to her. Then we walked in and looked around the glass house. A guide pointed out a tall palm and asked us to slow down near the signs. I picked up a map and put on my cap, because the sun came out. We walked through a wet path and stopped to look at a group of red flowers. After one hour, we looked over the map, sat down by a small pond, and took out some water. We ended up staying longer than we had planned. In the afternoon, the rain picked up, so we put away the map and headed back to the gate. I hung up our wet jackets and washed our hands. We dropped the map off at the desk and walked out with a small pot of green leaves. I smiled, because the garden had felt so quiet and fresh. We promised to come back in spring.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录；今日未连 Mac 读笔记，按日志错题模式出题，弱项还是短语动词连读和过去式听辨，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「周末去植物园」是全新的环境话题，短文里有 looked/arrived/lined/handed/walked/pointed/asked/picked/stopped/ended/planned/headed/washed/dropped/smiled/promised 等规则过去式；set off、looked up、wrote down、lined up、handed over、walked in、looked around、pointed out、slow down、picked up、put on、came out、walked through、sat down、took out、ended up、looked over、put away、headed back、hung up、dropped off、walked out、come back 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
